🖼️ Mapbox Demo Screenshot Collages

📋 Instructions

  1. First, run the screenshot capture script: node capture-screenshots.js
  2. Click on each placeholder below to upload the corresponding screenshot
  3. Use the download buttons to save collages as PNG files
  4. Upload the collages to your repository and update the README
